name: lr_dparity_symmetric
description: Manifestly left-right symmetric model between M_I and M_GUT (unbroken D-parity): three generations of LR fermions, one complex bidoublet Phi(1,2,2,0), and BOTH triplets Delta_L(1,3,1,2) and Delta_R(1,1,3,2) light. g_L = g_R is imposed at M_I (split_at_MI = lr_parity), so the system is over-determined and the residual is a genuine test. No GUT-scale threshold fields.
